BIO_DATA

I'm Mahmoud Eid Abdel Rahman, a Frontend and Flutter developer based in Tanta, Egypt, currently studying Computer & Control Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering, Tanta University (expected graduation 2027). I focus on the small details of an interface, and I enjoy watching an idea move from a design file to something that actually works.

I've been freelancing since October 2025, building websites and Flutter apps for individual clients, and I keep learning new tools to stay current with the industry.
